pred_reasoning_trace: A 30‐year‐old woman presented with a 2-month history of a swelling in her right cheek associated with severe pain. On examination, there was a diffuse extraoral swelling over the right cheek. Intraorally, a solitary, mobile, 2 cm × 2 cm submucosal mass with ill-defined borders and a smooth mucosal surface was noted on the right buccal mucosa without colour change. Ultrasonography showed a well-defined, hypoechoic lesion in the right cheek region. Based on the clinical and radiographic findings, a provisional diagnosis of an ectopic lymph node versus a lipoma was made.
